name: Potato Chips
description: Polyphonic chiptune oscillators, FM synth voices, editable wavetables, envelopes, and effects inspired by classic sound chips.
author: Christian Kauten

modules.name: Facets
modules.description: Four digital oscillators with tonal and stepped-noise waveforms, based on Mutable Instruments Edges. Formerly Blocks.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Mutable Instruments Edges sine triangle NES LFSR sample-and-hold Blocks

modules.name: Operator 2612
modules.description: Single Yamaha YM2612 FM operator with an envelope, feedback, and external modulation, from the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive. Formerly Mini Boss.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Yamaha YM2612 OPN2 Sega Genesis Mega Drive FM frequency modulation single operator SSG-EG Mini Boss

modules.name: Octal 163
modules.description: Eight Namco 163 wavetable oscillators with five editable waves and morphing, from NES / Famicom cartridges. Formerly Name Corp Octal Wave Generator.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Namco 163 N163 N106 Nintendo NES Famicom wavetable morphing drawing Name Corp Octal Wave Generator

modules.name: Voice 2612
modules.description: Four-operator Yamaha YM2612 FM synth voice with eight algorithms and looping envelopes, from the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive. Formerly Boss Fight.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Yamaha YM2612 OPN2 Sega Genesis Mega Drive FM frequency modulation four operator SSG-EG Boss Fight

modules.name: Contour 2612
modules.description: Passive reference panel illustrating the Voice 2612 Yamaha YM2612 envelope stages. Formerly Boss Fight Envelope Generator (Blank).
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Yamaha YM2612 OPN2 Sega Genesis Mega Drive ADSR envelope reference diagram Boss Fight Envelope Generator (Blank)

modules.name: Staircase 2A03
modules.description: Two pulse oscillators, triangle, and noise from the Ricoh 2A03 in the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES). Formerly Infinite Stairs.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Ricoh 2A03 Nintendo NES Famicom APU pulse square triangle PWM duty cycle Infinite Stairs

modules.name: Trio AY
modules.description: Three General Instrument AY-3-8910 tone channels with shared noise, looping envelopes, and stepped DAC operation. Formerly Jairasullator.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro General Instrument AY-3-8910 AY8910 PSG pulse square DAC amplitude modulation Jairasullator

modules.name: Pulse FME-7
modules.description: Three pulse oscillators emulating the Sunsoft FME-7 sound chip from NES / Famicom cartridges. Formerly Pulses.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sunsoft FME-7 FME7 Nintendo NES Famicom pulse square Pulses

modules.name: Pocket APU
modules.description: Game Boy sound system with two pulse oscillators, an editable morphing wavetable, and noise. Formerly Pallet Town Waves System.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Nintendo Game Boy Gameboy GB DMG APU pulse square wavetable morphing drawing Pallet Town Waves System

modules.name: Polynomial
modules.description: Four Atari POKEY tone/noise channels with selectable distortion, clock, and high-pass modes. Formerly Pot Keys.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Atari POKEY pulse square LFSR polynomial distortion high-pass Pot Keys

modules.name: Contour
modules.description: Two envelope generators based on the Sony S-DSP in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES). Formerly Super ADSR.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-DSP SDSP SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom ADSR attack decay sustain release Super ADSR

modules.name: Echo
modules.description: Stereo Sony S-DSP echo with feedback and an eight-tap FIR filter, from the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES). Formerly Super Echo.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-DSP SDSP SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom stereo echo FIR feedback comb Super Echo

modules.name: Gaussian
modules.description: Two Sony S-DSP-style Gaussian interpolation filters and VCAs with signed gain and 8-bit input quantization. Formerly Super VCA.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-DSP SDSP SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom Gaussian interpolation stereo quantization Super VCA

modules.name: Silicon S-SMP
modules.description: Passive panel illustrating the Sony S-SMP sound CPU from the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES). Formerly S-SMP Blank.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Sony S-SMP SSMP SPC700 SNES Super Nintendo Super Famicom chip illustration S-SMP Blank

modules.name: Tone 76489
modules.description: Three pulse oscillators and periodic/white noise from the Texas Instruments SN76489 in the Sega Master System and Genesis. Formerly Mega Tone.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Texas Instruments TI SN76489 PSG Sega Master System Mega Drive Genesis pulse square LFSR Mega Tone

modules.name: Ramp VRC6
modules.description: Two pulse oscillators and a stepped sawtooth from the Konami VRC6 sound chip in NES / Famicom cartridges. Formerly Step Saw.
modules.keywords: Potato Chips KautenjaDSP chiptune retro Konami VRC6 Nintendo NES Famicom pulse square sawtooth PWM duty cycle Step Saw
